question: Does the bundle-free prove-only path work, and what does it save?
answer: Yes. The launcher computed the source fingerprint at home, the pod agreed, and the run shipped no bundle, installed nothing and compiled nothing: 2 min 39 s of in-pod work against the A40 cache-hit run's 3 min 3 s, with only 7 s of it before proving began.

against_the_same_card_building.reading: +2.7%, within the 0.8-0.9% within-side spread doubled; the cached binary proves the same statement at the same speed

defect_found_and_fixed_before_launch.defect: the proof was wrapped in /usr/bin/time -v, which pod-run.sh installs from apt and this path deliberately skips; the stock image does not carry it, so the proof would have died on a stopwatch
defect_found_and_fixed_before_launch.fix: use the timer when present, say so when absent
defect_found_and_fixed_before_launch.confirmed_by: the run logged 'note: /usr/bin/time is absent; timing comes from the harness's own report'

limits: no off-pod verification: proof bytes stayed on the pod
the saving over pod-run.sh on a hit is 24 s of in-pod work plus the 29 s upload the launcher no longer makes; the ~110 s image pull is untouched and remains the largest phase
